results.question: Show FIR cases registered in Bengaluru Urban district in the last 6 months
results.generated_sql:
SELECT cm."CaseMasterID", d."DistrictName", cm."CrimeNo", cm."CrimeRegisteredDate", ch."CrimeGroupName"
FROM "CaseMaster" cm
JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
JOIN "District" d ON d."DistrictID" = u."DistrictID"
JOIN "CaseCategory" cc ON cc."CaseCategoryID" = cm."CaseCategoryID"
JOIN "CrimeHead" ch ON ch."CrimeHeadID" = cm."CrimeMajorHeadID"
WHERE cc."LookupValue" = 'FIR'
  AND d."DistrictName" = 'Bengaluru Urban'
  AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '6 months'
ORDER BY cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" DESC
LIMIT 200

results.question: Which districts have rising crime this month compared to last month?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT d."DistrictName", current_month.crimes AS current_month_crimes, last_month.crimes AS last_month_crimes
FROM "District" d
JOIN (
    SELECT u."DistrictID", COUNT(*) AS crimes
    FROM "CaseMaster" cm
    JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
    WHERE cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
    GROUP BY u."DistrictID"
) current_month ON current_month."DistrictID" = d."DistrictID"
JOIN (
    SELECT u."DistrictID", COUNT(*) AS crimes
    FROM "CaseMaster" cm
    JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
    WHERE cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month')
      AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
    GROUP BY u."DistrictID"
) last_month ON last_month."DistrictID" = d."DistrictID"
WHERE current_month.crimes > last_month.crimes
ORDER BY current_month.crimes - last_month.crimes DESC LIMIT 500
